TOPIC: Get great travel discounts on Travafa
TARGET_AUDIENCE: Indian travellers aged 22-35, app-first, price-aware, who compare across several sites before booking anything and are convinced they are always one tab away from a better price
PRODUCT_FOCUS: Comparing the available options in one place before booking
KNOWN_PRODUCT_CAPABILITIES: Browse curated places based on stated preferences
Search and book flights: one-way or round-trip, with from, to, depart date, travellers and cabin
Create a trip that holds multiple destinations and a count of activities
Plan a trip together with other travellers on one shared trip
Create Memories from photos already on the phone (app only)
DESTINATION: not fixed - the traveller is still deciding
CREATIVE_ANGLE: Hunting for a better price is its own full-time job. You open a sixth tab, the first price has changed, and you no longer know whether you found a deal or just lost an hour.
